tasks.title: Code Review 2026 Follow-up: Refactor handle_chat_completion (ARCH-7)
tasks.description: Break up the massive ~1000+ line handle_chat_completion in src/acp/mod.rs. This is currently the biggest maintainability risk.
tasks.details:
Refactor complete (Task 280). 

- 280.1: context_trim.rs fully extracted and in use.
- 280.2/280.3: Tool loop orchestration + message ownership moved to ChatTurn (chat_turn.rs) with new `ChatTurn::run()` method. handle_chat_completion is now a thin Phase-1 setup + delegation.
- 280.4: emit_context_and_status + thinking/status emission extracted.
- 280.5: Permission gate + cancellation checks isolated in process_tool_calls.

Deprecated duplicate helpers (estimate_tokens, trim_to_token_budget, model_context_budget, truncate_tool_results, build_archive_notice, old ModelContextInfo table) removed from mod.rs.

handle_chat_completion is now ~80 lines of setup + one `turn.run(...)` call.

Full cargo test recommended. Subtasks marked done.
tasks.testStrategy: After refactor, run full cargo test. Add targeted unit tests for extracted modules. Manual smoke test via 'grok acp stdio' + Zed if available.

subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for estimate_tokens, trim_to_token_budget, truncate_tool_results, and compression path (with mock router).

subtasks.description: Modify setup_session_dna() in src/bin/installer.rs to prefer .grok/session_dna.json as the source during installation.
subtasks.details:
The installer currently has partial logic that checks .grok/ first. Ensure it:
- Prefers .grok/session_dna.json as the canonical source for new installs.
- Gracefully skips or ignores a bare root-level session_dna.json (for transition safety).
- Updates console messages and comments to reflect the recommended .grok/ location.
- Copies the file to ~/.grok-cli/session_dna.json as before.
subtasks.testStrategy:
1. Create a temp project with both .grok/session_dna.json and a root session_dna.json.
2. Run installer logic (or the installer binary).
3. Verify it copies from .grok/ (not the bare root file).
4. Confirm messages mention the .grok/ path.
